import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

def scrape_wikipedia(url):
    response = requests.get(url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    links = soup.find_all('a')
    return links

def download_image(link):
    if 'wikipedia.org' in link.get('href', ''):
        img_url = f'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?format=json&action=query&prop=pageimages&pithumbsize=1024&inprop=url&pageids={link.get("href").split("--")[0]}'
        resp = requests.get(img_url)
        img_data = resp.json()
        img = img_data['pages'][0]['thump']
        return img.get('url')

url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Random'
links = scrape_wikipedia(url)
links = [link for link in links if link.get('href', '')]
